meta.text: Let's do the worked example. Cold join recompute is 12 seconds, the cache write costs 9 seconds, and each warm read is 1 second. The break-even reuse count is roughly (9 − 1) ÷ (12 − 1), which works out to one reuse. So a second use already pays for itself. But run this job only once and you have spent 9 seconds writing to memory for zero benefit — and that memory may evict data other stages need.
